title: I made an Android game about a cow escaping aliens - looking for honest feedback 🐄🛸
author: ComfortableLoose3099
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m the solo dev behind BOVNI: Fuga do Pasto, a small Android arcade game I’ve been working on.

You play as a cow trying to escape an alien invasion — jumping over obstacles, dashing through danger, grabbing power-ups and surviving for as long as possible.

I’ve recently been working on new skins, environments, weather changes and polishing the gameplay, and I’d really like to get some feedback from people who haven’t played it before.

Google Play:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3chforge.bovni

If you give it a try, I’m especially curious about:

\- Does the jump + dash feel intuitive?

\- Was it obvious what you were supposed to do?

\- What usually ended your run?

\- Did anything feel unfair, frustrating or too easy?

\- Most importantly: was it actually fun enough to make you want another run?

The game is free and contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

For transparency, I also use AI tools during development, including for some visual asset generation.

Thanks to anyone who gives it a shot. I’m actively working on the game, so criticism is genuinely useful — even if your feedback is just “I played for 2 minutes and this annoyed me.” 😅

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body: I give you points for coming up with an original idea. Well done.

replies.author: ComfortableLoose3099
replies.body: Thanks! Cow abductions are such a classic alien cliché that I honestly kept wondering why I had never seen it turned into a full game. So I decided to flip it around and make the cow escape instead 😄
